DataSource.query:
begin
select
    concat(accod.COD_ACCOUNTING_CODE,aclog.COD_ACCOUNTING_LOG) as BOOK,
    FORMAT(dat.[DATE], 'yyyy') as NUM_YEAR,
    FORMAT(dat.[DATE], 'MM') as NUM_MONTH,
    'MOD-'+ mod.COD_PRODUCT_MODEL as PRODUCT_MODEL,
    srccomp.COD_COMPANY as ORIGIN_COMPANY,
    alloc.ID_ALLOCATION, 
    concat('C-', acct.COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT) as COD_ACC_ACCOUNT,
    CASE WHEN grp.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP in ('99', '90') then concat(grp.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP, '-', grp.LAB_CUSTOMER_GROUP_EN)
    ELSE 'Others' end as PREV_IC_MAPPING,
    SUM(fsl.AMT_NET_ENTRY_SOURCE_COMP_CUR* -1) as NET_ENTRY_EUROS
FROM ACCOUNTING.FACT_SAVING_LEDGER fsl
    INNER JOIN common.DIM_DATE_VIEW dat on dat.SEQ_DAY = fsl.SEQ_ENTRY_DAY
    LEFT join COMMON.DIM_ALLOCATION alloc on fsl.SEQ_ALLOCATION = alloc.SEQ_ALLOCATION
    LEFT JOIN common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_CODE accod on accod.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_CODE = fsl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_CODE
    LEFT JOIN common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_LOG aclog on aclog.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_LOG = fsl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_LOG
    LEFT JOIN common.DIM_CUSTOMER_COGNOS cust on cust.SEQ_CUSTOMER_COGNOS = fsl.SEQ_INVOICE_CUSTOMER_COGNOS
    LEFT JOIN common.DIM_COMPANY invcomp on invcomp.SEQ_COMPANY = fsl.SEQ_INVOICE_COMPANY
    LEFT JOIN common.DIM_COMPANY srccomp on srccomp.SEQ_COMPANY = fsl.SEQ_SOURCE_COMPANY
    LEFT JOIN common.DIM_COMPANY mgtcomp on mgtcomp.SEQ_COMPANY = fsl.SEQ_MANAGEMENT_COMPANY
    LEFT JOIN common.DIM_CUSTOMER_GROUP grp on grp.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP = cust.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP and substring(grp.ID_CUSTOMER_GROUP, 1, 1) = invcomp.COD_COMPANY
    LEFT JOIN COMMON.DIM_PRODUCT_MODEL mod on fsl.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL = mod.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL
    LEFT JOIN COMMON.DIM_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT acct on acct.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT = fsl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT
	LEFT JOIN COMMON.DIM_BUCHER_ACCOUNT bacct on acct.SEQ_BUCHER_ACCOUNT_DEBIT = bacct.SEQ_BUCHER_ACCOUNT
WHERE fsl.AMT_NET_ENTRY_SOURCE_COMP_CUR <> 0 and year(dat.[DATE]) >= year(DATEADD(YEAR, -2, GETDATE())) 
and fsl.BIT_UNIQUE_INVOICING = '0'
GROUP BY
    concat(accod.COD_ACCOUNTING_CODE,aclog.COD_ACCOUNTING_LOG),
    FORMAT(dat.[DATE], 'yyyy'),
    FORMAT(dat.[DATE], 'MM'),
    'MOD-'+ mod.COD_PRODUCT_MODEL,
    srccomp.COD_COMPANY,
    alloc.ID_ALLOCATION,
    concat('C-', acct.COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT),
    CASE WHEN grp.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP in ('99', '90') then concat(grp.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP, '-', grp.LAB_CUSTOMER_GROUP_EN)
    ELSE 'Others' end
end
